original.target_description: Experiment 1, page 4: CRT-score association with composite moral acceptability across three dilemmas. Both CRT-First and Dilemmas-First correlations are printed; supplied description does not distinguish the condition.

n.sample_role: Participants within the relevant condition; intended condition unresolved.
n.exclusions: The initial between-condition means analysis explicitly excludes participants with zero correct CRT items. Whether this restriction applies to the page-4 correlations is not stated there; page 6 describes individual-dilemma correlations across all subjects.
n.quote:
Pre-Exclusion CRT-First: 65 of 150 [43%],
Post-Exclusion CRT-First: 41 of 92 [45%] ... Again collapsing across all three dilemmas, we examined data from subjects in the CRT-
First condition and observed a robust positive correlation between CRT scores and moral
acceptability ratings, consistent with our second prediction (r = .39, p = .001; see Fig. 1).
However, there was no such correlation among subjects in the Dilemmas-First condition
(r = ).03, p = .8)
